scenario: Given an applicant opens checking account with initial verified debit transfer of $25.00, when opening request is submitted.
expected: Account is successfully created in Active status with opening ledger balance of $25.00 and no validation errors.

scenario: Given an applicant attempts to open checking account with initial deposit of $24.99, when opening request is submitted.
expected: Account opening is declined, transaction blocked with error code ERR_MIN_DEPOSIT, and no account record is activated.

scenario: Given an active checking account maintains an average daily balance of $1,500.00 during the 30-day statement cycle, when monthly cycle cut-off runs.
expected: Monthly maintenance fee is waived ($0.00 assessed) with waiver code BAL_WAIVER logged in statement record.

scenario: Given an active checking account with average daily balance of $1,499.50 and $0 direct deposits, when monthly cycle cut-off runs.
expected: Monthly maintenance fee of exactly $12.00 is debited from the account balance under transaction code MTH_FEE.

scenario: Given an account with $0.00 available balance enrolled in overdraft protection incurs a POS debit of $5.00, resulting in negative balance of -$5.00.
expected: Transaction completes successfully, new balance is -$5.00, and no overdraft fee is assessed ($0.00 fee) per the $5.00 tolerance rule.

scenario: Given an enrolled account with $0.00 balance incurs a debit of $5.01, resulting in negative balance of -$5.01, and 0 prior overdraft fees today.
expected: Transaction completes, balance is debited by $5.01 plus $35.00 overdraft fee, leaving new balance at -$40.01.

scenario: Given a high-yield savings account with end-of-day available balance of $10,000.00 on day 15 of cycle.
expected: Daily interest is accrued at Tier 2 rate of 3.25% APY ($10,000.00 * 0.0325 / 365 = $0.8904 rounded to $0.89).

scenario: Given a customer submits an outbound domestic wire of $25,000.00 with verified identity and sufficient funds.
expected: Wire executes immediately without requiring dual compliance officer authorization.

scenario: Given a customer submits an outbound domestic wire of $25,000.01 with sufficient funds.
expected: Wire is placed into Pending_Officer_Review state and cannot disburse funds until dual compliance authorization is recorded.

scenario: Given a personal loan applicant with calculated DTI of exactly 43.0% including prospective monthly payment of $320.00.
expected: Applicant passes DTI eligibility threshold and proceeds to FICO credit tier assessment.

scenario: Given a personal loan applicant with calculated DTI of 43.1% including prospective monthly payment.
expected: Application is declined automatically with adverse action reason code DTI_EXCEEDED.

scenario: Given an applicant with FICO score of 745 requests personal loan of $45,000.00 with verified qualifying income.
expected: Application is approved under Tier A parameters ($50,000.00 maximum loan ceiling).

scenario: Given an applicant with FICO score of 619 submits a personal loan application.
expected: Application is declined automatically due to credit score falling below the minimum threshold of 620.

scenario: Given applicant identity passport has expiration date of 2026-10-20 and application is submitted on 2026-10-21.
expected: KYC verification service blocks application submission with error code KYC_EXPIRED_ID.

scenario: Given a customer completes a cash deposit of $10,001.00 at a branch teller.
expected: Deposit transaction is credited and an automated FinCEN Form 112 CTR filing record is generated in compliance queue.

scenario: Given a customer with $400.00 in ATM cash withdrawals in the past 24 hours attempts an additional ATM withdrawal of $600.00.
expected: Transaction is approved as cumulative 24-hour total ($1,000.00) equals the $1,000.00 daily limit.

scenario: Given a customer with $900.00 in ATM cash withdrawals in the past 24 hours attempts an additional ATM withdrawal of $120.00.
expected: Transaction is declined with response code 61 (Exceeds withdrawal amount limit).
